items.item_text: Surgical Technician Training Course Graduate and 1 year experience in acute care/stand alone ambulatory surgery center with focus on Ortho, Laparoscopic procedures, vascular, ophthalmology; or successful completion of a student clinical rotation at Glendale Memorial Hospital.

Demonstrates adherence to the Standards of Conduct Requirements. Completes and turns in the SOC acknowledgement card .Fulfils compliance education requirements as directed by the compliance department or department management.

Performs scrub functions for all general or minor specialty cases. Demonstrates competence in use of the computer to generate case cart pick lists and physician preference lists. Updates physician preference lists as necessary.

Demonstrates knowledge of safe principles of positioning patients intra-operatively. Understands the relationship between anatomy and physiology and positioning and recognizes potential safety hazards to the patient.

Demonstrates knowledge of principles of aseptic technique. Demonstrates competency in the operation of : Decontamination unit Steam autoclave Chemical sterilization unit Utilizes resources and resource material as appropriate
Adheres to hospital policies, departmental policies and AORN recommended practices.
Establishes and maintains positive interpersonal relationships with patients, visitors and other hospital personnel.
